notes:
High-level: Resolvea runs an enterprise contact center platform that provides outsourcing & tech to midsize telco and fintech customers. Current pain: post-call QA and coaching is manual (team of 20 QA specialists), summaries inconsistent, coaching highlights missed. They want automated post-call summaries (coaching bullet points + QA scoring), transcript ingestion, and CRM tool-calls to create/update Zendesk tickets and send coaching nudges to managers.

Technical profile: avg handle time 6m, peak live calls 900/hr, expected POC ingestion ~250 calls/day, eventual target 5k calls/day. Audio is noisy (call center floor + PSTN triangle). Key asks: streaming transcripts for near‑real-time agent assist (live whisper), accurate post-call summaries (extract coaching highlights: 'agent missed ask-for-referral', 'escalation opportunity'), structured QA outputs (scores + reason codes), and safe tool-calling that maps extracted intents to Zendesk fields.

Security & compliance: must support SSO/SAML (Okta), SOC2 attestation, per-customer data residency (EU customers routed to EU region), KMS integration for key management, audit logging for transcript access, retention controls (default 90 days, option to extend to 2 years for regulated customers). On-prem option desirable for a set of customers; initial preference is Redwood Dedicated with VPC peering.

Procurement & stakeholders: primary sponsor: Head of Product (Nina Patel). Technical champion: Platform Lead (Ravi Shah). Legal leads: counsel (Elaine Morris). Finance will only sign for >100k ARR.

Quotes from calls: "We need coaching highlights that our supervisors actually trust — not long paragraphs, 3 bullets max." "If we get false positives in QA scoring, the supervisors will ignore it — precision matters more than recall for now."

POC scope and success criteria: 4-week POC to validate streaming transcription accuracy (target WER <7% on mic/noisy audio), summary quality measured by panel (target 4/5 average usefulness), automated ticket creation correctness >90% mapping to Zendesk fields, and sustained throughput 1k calls/hour without degraded latency.

Operational concerns: cost sensitivity on tokens for post-call summarization at scale; interested in Redwood Optimize recommendations (batching + quantization). They also want fallback routing: hosted model -> dedicated -> smaller quantized local instance to maintain service during spikes.

Misc quick bullets: trial timeline tight — Q2 pilot start requested; looking for sample infra diagram, sample PII redaction strategy, and SAML test user by 2026-03-05.
